title: Deep learning from multiple experts improves identification of amyloid neuropathologies.
summary: CNN ensembles combined five expert annotation schemes to identify amyloid neuropathologies, with held-out evaluation and a prospective blind research filter assessment.
ai_technology: Methods describe whole-slide image train/holdout split, four-fold models and expert ensembles; Results and prospective phase-two evaluate identification of cored plaques and cerebral amyloid angiopathy.
